text: Legal immigration should be significantly reduced.
context: Legal immigration means people moving to a country through regular channels: work, study, family or refuge. Cutting it means tighter rules for visas and residence permits. The debate weighs labour needs and family ties against pressure on housing, services and social cohesion.

origin.text_fr: Il faut réduire significativement l'immigration légale en France.

text: Violent criminals get off too lightly.
context: This is about longer maximum sentences for violent crimes. Supporters say tougher sentences deter offenders and protect the public; critics say the certainty of being caught matters more than the length of the sentence.

origin.text_fr: Les peines pour les crimes et délits violents doivent être alourdies.

text: The very rich should pay far more tax.
context: A wealth tax is levied on what people own, not what they earn. Supporters say great fortunes grow faster than wages and should contribute more; critics say the rich can move their money abroad and that assets are hard to value.

origin.text_fr: Il faut augmenter les impôts sur les très grandes fortunes.

text: The legal retirement age should be lowered.
context: As people live longer, pensions cost more, and governments often respond by raising the retirement age. Lowering it means more years of retirement, paid for by higher contributions, higher taxes or lower pensions.

origin.text_fr: L'âge légal de départ à la retraite doit être abaissé.

text: My country should enforce ICC arrest warrants, even against the leaders of allies.
context: The International Criminal Court can issue arrest warrants for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity. Member states are obliged to arrest suspects on their territory, even when the suspect leads a friendly country.

origin.text_fr: La France doit appliquer les mandats d'arrêt de la CPI, y compris contre des dirigeants de pays alliés.

text: My country should leave the European Union.
context: Leaving the EU means leaving the single market, the customs union and EU law, and negotiating new trade deals from outside. Supporters stress sovereignty and control over laws and borders; opponents stress trade, jobs and influence.

origin.text_fr: La France doit quitter l'Union Européenne.

text: Every vote should count the same: parliament should be elected by proportional representation.
context: In winner-takes-all systems, each district elects one representative, which favours large parties and usually produces single-party governments. Proportional representation gives parties seats in line with their share of the vote, which tends to mean coalitions.

origin.text_fr: Une part de représentation proportionnelle doit être introduite aux législatives.

text: Hospitals and schools need an army of new public hires, whatever it costs.
context: Hiring many more nurses, doctors and teachers means much higher public spending, paid for by taxes or borrowing. Supporters say understaffing costs lives and learning; critics ask where the money and the trained staff will come from.

origin.text_fr: L'État doit embaucher massivement dans les hôpitaux et l'Éducation nationale.

text: The minimum wage should be raised significantly.
context: A statutory minimum wage sets the lowest legal pay. Raising it lifts the incomes of the lowest paid; critics warn it can cost jobs or push up prices if it rises faster than productivity.

origin.text_fr: Le SMIC doit être augmenté significativement.

text: Nuclear power should be a pillar of energy policy.
context: Nuclear power is low-carbon and runs whatever the weather, but brings accident risk, long-lived waste and huge up-front costs. The debate is whether it is a necessary backbone for a low-carbon grid or an expensive detour from renewables.

origin.text_fr: Le nucléaire doit rester un pilier de la politique énergétique française.

text: Private companies would run some public services better than the state does.
context: Public services can be handed to private operators through contracts, concessions or outright privatisation. Supporters point to efficiency and innovation; critics to profit-taking, unequal access and the risk of services failing.

origin.text_fr: Une partie des services publics devrait être ouverte à la gestion privée.

text: My country should leave NATO.
context: NATO is a military alliance whose members promise to defend one another if attacked. Leaving means giving up that guarantee and any say in the alliance, in exchange for full independence in defence and foreign policy.

origin.text_fr: La France doit quitter l'OTAN.

text: Citizens should be able to force a national referendum by collecting signatures.
context: A citizens' initiative lets a set number of voters force a referendum, bypassing parliament. Supporters call it direct democracy; critics say it reduces complex issues to yes or no and favours well-funded campaigns.

origin.text_fr: Il faut instaurer le référendum d'initiative citoyenne (RIC).

text: School uniforms should be made compulsory in schools.
context: Supporters of school uniforms say they hide differences in wealth, reduce peer pressure and build a sense of belonging. Opponents point to the cost for families and the loss of self-expression.

origin.text_fr: L'uniforme scolaire doit être rendu obligatoire dans les écoles.

text: Governments should end all subsidies for fossil fuels.
context: Governments support fossil fuels through tax breaks, cheap fuel for particular industries and direct aid. Ending it would align spending with climate goals, but could raise prices for households and hit industries that depend on cheap energy.

origin.text_fr: La France doit mettre fin à ses subventions aux énergies fossiles.

text: Recreational cannabis should be legalised.
context: Legalising recreational cannabis means the state regulating its production and sale, as it does alcohol. Supporters cite tax revenue, safer products and less organised crime; opponents cite the health risks, especially for young people.

origin.text_fr: Il faut légaliser le cannabis récréatif.

text: Former colonial powers should officially apologise for their colonial past.
context: Colonial empires were built through conquest, slavery and the violent repression of independence movements. Supporters of an apology see it as owed recognition; opponents say today's citizens aren't responsible, or worry about claims for reparations.

origin.text_fr: La France doit présenter des excuses officielles pour son passé colonial.

text: Borrow big and build. The deficit can wait.
context: The case for: borrow now to repair infrastructure, fund the green transition and revive industry, and growth will pay it back. The case against: more debt means higher interest costs and less room to respond to the next crisis.

origin.text_fr: L'État doit lancer un grand plan d'investissements publics, même au prix d'un déficit aggravé.

text: Free healthcare for undocumented migrants should be abolished.
context: Some countries give undocumented migrants access to routine healthcare; others offer emergency care only. Supporters cite public health and the higher cost of treating illness late; opponents say it encourages irregular migration.

origin.text_fr: L'aide médicale d'État (AME) pour les sans-papiers doit être supprimée.

text: Rich countries should increase their development aid to the Global South.
context: Development aid funds health, education and infrastructure in poorer countries. Supporters see it as a duty and an investment in stability; critics question whether it works and say the money is needed at home.

origin.text_fr: La France doit accroître son aide au développement des pays du Sud.

text: Birthright citizenship should be abolished.
context: Under birthright citizenship, anyone born in a country becomes a citizen. Supporters say it makes children born and raised there full members of society; opponents say citizenship should depend on the parents' status or ties to the country.

origin.text_fr: Il faut mettre fin au droit du sol en France.

text: Foreigners without legal status should be systematically deported.
context: Deportation orders often go unenforced, for lack of travel documents, cooperation from countries of origin, or because of legal appeals. Systematic removal would mean more detention and enforcement, and raises questions about people's rights and ties.

origin.text_fr: Les étrangers en situation irrégulière doivent être expulsés systématiquement.

text: Foreign residents with legal status should get the right to vote in local elections.
context: Some countries let foreign residents vote in local elections after a period of legal residence; others reserve it for citizens. Supporters say those who live and pay taxes somewhere should have a say; opponents say voting should come with citizenship.

origin.text_fr: Le droit de vote aux élections locales doit être accordé aux étrangers résidents en situation régulière.

text: Foreigners should have to wait 5 years before they can receive welfare benefits.
context: A waiting period would make access to welfare depend on a minimum length of legal residence. Supporters say it stops welfare from drawing migrants in; critics say it pushes newcomers into poverty.

origin.text_fr: Les étrangers devraient attendre 5 ans avant d'accéder aux aides sociales.

text: Dual citizenship should be restricted.
context: Dual citizenship means holding two passports and civic rights in two countries. Supporters say it reflects lives lived across borders; critics question divided loyalty. One proposal is to make people choose a single nationality when they come of age.

origin.text_fr: La double nationalité franco-étrangère devrait être restreinte.

text: Let workers in first. Everyone else can wait.
context: Immigration channels include work, family reunification and asylum. Prioritising labour migrants means faster procedures or easier permits for people with a job or needed skills, and relatively fewer places for everyone else.

origin.text_fr: Les immigrés venant travailler doivent être prioritaires sur les autres pour l'accueil en France.

text: Family reunification should be made easier.
context: Family reunification lets a legally resident foreigner bring over a spouse and children, usually subject to income and housing conditions. The debate is between the right to family life and control over immigration numbers.

origin.text_fr: Il faut faciliter le regroupement familial.

text: My country should take in more asylum seekers.
context: Asylum is protection for people fleeing persecution or war. Besides those who arrive and claim asylum, countries can resettle refugees directly from abroad. This is about taking in more of both.

origin.text_fr: La France doit accueillir davantage de demandeurs d'asile.

text: Repeat offenders should face mandatory minimum sentences.
context: Mandatory minimums set an automatic floor on sentences for repeat offenders, leaving judges no discretion. Supporters say they guarantee firmness; critics say they fill prisons without cutting crime and stop judges weighing each case.

origin.text_fr: Il faut rétablir des peines planchers pour les récidivistes.

text: Juvenile offenders aged 16 and over should be tried as adults.
context: Most justice systems treat young offenders differently, putting education and rehabilitation ahead of punishment. This is about giving 16- and 17-year-olds the same criminal responsibility, and the same sentences, as adults.

origin.text_fr: Les mineurs délinquants doivent être jugés comme des majeurs à partir de 16 ans.

text: Part of everyone's pension should be invested in the stock market.
context: In pay-as-you-go pensions, today's workers fund today's retirees. In funded pensions, people save and invest for their own retirement. Supporters say a funded share boosts pensions; critics cite market risk and weaker solidarity between generations.

origin.text_fr: Il faut développer la retraite par capitalisation en complément de la répartition.

text: Prison is the wrong punishment for non-violent crime.
context: Alternatives to prison include electronic tagging, community service and suspended sentences. Supporters cite rehabilitation, cost and overcrowded prisons; critics call them too lenient.

origin.text_fr: Les peines alternatives à l'emprisonnement (bracelet, TIG, sursis) doivent être privilégiées pour les délits non-violents.

text: An independent authority should be created to investigate police violence.
context: Complaints against the police are often investigated by the police themselves. An independent body would be separate from both the police and the government. Supporters say only that earns public trust; critics fear it undermines police morale.

origin.text_fr: Il faut créer une autorité indépendante pour enquêter sur les violences policières.

text: Being an MP should be a full-time job, with no side income.
context: Some parliaments let members keep outside jobs alongside their seat. Supporters of a ban say representing people is a full-time job and outside pay creates conflicts of interest; opponents say outside work keeps politicians in touch with the real world.

origin.text_fr: Un mandat de parlementaire doit être incompatible avec l'exercice de toute autre activité professionnelle rémunérée.

text: More prison places should be built.
context: When prisons are overcrowded, the choice is between building more of them and sending fewer people there. Building costs a lot and takes years; sentencing fewer people raises questions of public safety.

origin.text_fr: Il faut créer davantage de places de prison.

text: Social media platforms should be held liable for harmful content posted by their users.
context: Platforms are generally not treated as publishers of what their users post, which limits their legal liability. Making them liable would push them to remove more harmful content, but also, critics fear, more legitimate speech.

origin.text_fr: Les réseaux sociaux doivent être tenus responsables des contenus préjudiciables publiés par leurs utilisateurs.

text: Farmers should be guaranteed a price they can live on, whatever the market says.
context: A floor price is a guaranteed minimum below which farm produce can't be sold, meant to cover farmers' costs and pay. Supporters say farmers are squeezed by processors and supermarkets; critics warn it can raise food prices or create surpluses.

origin.text_fr: L'État doit garantir des prix planchers rémunérateurs pour les agriculteurs.

text: Nobody should inherit a fortune without paying extra for it.
context: Inheritance taxes are usually progressive, and often lower for close family. Supporters say large inheritances entrench inequality from one generation to the next; opponents see taxing them as punishing families for passing on what they built.

origin.text_fr: Il faut instaurer une contribution exceptionnelle sur les successions de plus de 2 millions d'euros.

text: Employers pay too much to hire people.
context: Employers pay contributions on wages that fund social protection: health, pensions, unemployment. Cutting them lowers the cost of hiring; the question is how the lost funding would be replaced.

origin.text_fr: Il faut baisser les cotisations patronales.

text: Take public money, and you don't get to move the jobs abroad.
context: Governments give companies subsidies, tax breaks and cheap loans. This would attach a condition: take the money, and you can't move jobs abroad for 10 years. Supporters call it fair; critics say it would scare off investment.

origin.text_fr: Les entreprises ayant bénéficié d'aides publiques ne doivent pas pouvoir délocaliser pendant 10 ans.

text: Energy and transport should belong to the state.
context: Nationalisation moves private companies into state ownership. Supporters say strategic sectors like energy and transport should serve the public, not shareholders; critics point to cost, inefficiency and political meddling.

origin.text_fr: Il faut nationaliser les secteurs stratégiques (énergie, transports).

text: My country should be able to override European human rights rulings to enforce its migration policy.
context: The European Convention on Human Rights protects family life and bans inhuman or degrading treatment, and its court can halt deportations. This is about letting a government set those rulings aside on migration, at the cost of weakening the convention.

origin.text_fr: La France doit pouvoir déroger à la CEDH pour mener sa politique migratoire.

text: Nuclear-armed states should commit to nuclear disarmament.
context: Nuclear disarmament means giving up nuclear weapons, gradually or by treaty. Supporters say they threaten catastrophe; opponents say deterrence keeps the peace between major powers and that disarming alone leaves a country exposed.

origin.text_fr: La France doit s'engager dans un processus de désarmement nucléaire.

text: The sale of new petrol and diesel cars should be banned by 2035.
context: Banning new petrol and diesel cars forces a switch to electric and other low-emission vehicles. Supporters say it gives industry a clear target; critics cite cost, charging infrastructure and the impact on carmakers and rural drivers.

origin.text_fr: La vente de véhicules thermiques neufs doit être interdite d'ici 2035.

text: A universal basic income should be introduced.
context: A universal basic income would pay every adult a fixed sum, with no means test and no work requirement. How much, how to fund it, and whether people would still work are the big arguments.

origin.text_fr: Il faut instaurer un revenu universel de base.

text: Food and soap shouldn't be taxed at all.
context: Sales taxes like VAT fall hardest on poorer households, who spend more of what they earn. Scrapping them on essentials like food and hygiene products helps those households, but the rich save money too and the state loses revenue.

origin.text_fr: La TVA sur les produits de première nécessité doit être supprimée.

text: The standard working week is too short.
context: The legal working week sets the hours above which overtime pay kicks in, or caps hours outright. A longer week could raise output and lower labour costs; opponents cite health, family life and fewer jobs to go round.

origin.text_fr: La durée légale du travail doit être portée au-dessus de 35 heures par semaine.

text: The right to strike in public services should be limited.
context: The right to strike is a basic protection for workers, but strikes in public services hit the people who depend on them. Limiting it could mean a guaranteed minimum service, longer notice, or bans in essential sectors.

origin.text_fr: Le droit de grève dans les services publics doit être limité.

text: Assisted reproduction should be fully reimbursed and access to it widened (age, medical criteria).
context: Assisted reproduction (IVF and related treatments) is often limited by age, medical criteria, waiting lists and partial funding, and access for single women and same-sex couples varies. This is about full public funding and wider access.

origin.text_fr: La PMA doit être intégralement remboursée et ses conditions d'accès élargies (âge, critères médicaux).

text: Surrogacy should be legal.
context: In surrogacy, a woman carries a child for another person or couple and hands it over at birth. The debate covers commodification of the body, the rights of the surrogate, equal rights for couples, and the interests of the child.

origin.text_fr: La gestation pour autrui (GPA) doit être légalisée en France.

text: Assisted dying should be legal.
context: Assisted dying means helping a terminally ill or suffering person end their life, through euthanasia or assisted suicide. Supporters cite autonomy and dignity; opponents fear pressure on vulnerable people and a slippery slope.

origin.text_fr: Le droit à l'aide à mourir (assistance médicale pour mettre fin à sa vie) doit être légalisé en France.

text: Access to abortion should be made easier and wider.
context: Abortion laws vary in time limits, cost and ease of access. This is about longer time limits, better local access and full public funding. The debate turns on bodily autonomy and on when the unborn should be protected.

origin.text_fr: Il faut faciliter et élargir l'accès à l'avortement.

text: The more you fly, the more tax you should pay per ticket.
context: Aviation is a significant and fast-growing source of emissions, and a small share of frequent flyers takes most flights. A progressive tax would rise with distance and with how often you fly.

origin.text_fr: Il faut instaurer une taxe carbone progressive sur les billets d'avion.

text: Workers should have as many seats on the board as shareholders.
context: In most companies, shareholders elect the board. Co-determination gives employees seats too; parity means half of them. Supporters say it leads to longer-term decisions; critics say it slows companies down and deters investors.

origin.text_fr: La gouvernance des grandes entreprises doit être partagée à égalité entre représentants des actionnaires et représentants des salariés.

text: Strict rent controls should be introduced in big cities.
context: Rent control caps rents or rent rises. Supporters say it protects tenants from being priced out; critics say it discourages building and maintenance and shrinks the supply of homes to rent.

origin.text_fr: Il faut instaurer un contrôle strict des loyers dans les grandes villes.

text: It should be easier to lay people off.
context: Laying off staff for economic reasons often involves consultation, notice periods, severance pay and sometimes official approval. Simplifying that lets companies adapt faster, at the cost of weaker protection for employees.

origin.text_fr: Les procédures de licenciement économique doivent être simplifiées.

text: The carbon tax should be raised.
context: A carbon tax raises the price of fossil fuels to cut emissions. It hits drivers and rural households hardest and can spark protests; some designs return the revenue to households as a rebate.

origin.text_fr: La taxe carbone doit être augmentée.

text: Factory farming should be phased out.
context: Intensive livestock farming keeps large numbers of animals in small spaces to cut costs. Phasing it out would improve animal welfare and reduce pollution, but raise the price of meat, eggs and milk.

origin.text_fr: Il faut interdire progressivement l'élevage intensif.

text: Pesticides should be phased out.
context: Synthetic pesticides raise yields but are contested for their effects on health, insects and water. A general ban would mean a shift to organic or low-input farming, with lower yields or higher costs.

origin.text_fr: Les pesticides doivent être progressivement interdits.

text: Renewable energy should make up 100% of the electricity mix by 2050.
context: A fully renewable grid runs on sun, wind, water and biomass. The challenge is intermittency: storing power and balancing the grid when there is no sun or wind. Getting there means rebuilding the whole generating fleet.

origin.text_fr: Les énergies renouvelables doivent représenter 100 % du mix électrique d'ici 2050.

text: No new motorways should be built.
context: Supporters say new motorways connect remote areas, ease congestion and help the economy. Opponents say they pave over land and generate more traffic and emissions, and that the money should go to public transport.

origin.text_fr: La France ne doit plus construire de nouvelles autoroutes.

text: National defence spending should reach 3% of GDP.
context: Defence spending is usually measured as a share of GDP. Raising it means more equipment, more recruits and more readiness for war; the money has to come from taxes, borrowing or other budgets.

origin.text_fr: Le budget de la défense nationale doit atteindre 3 % du PIB.

text: Oil companies' crisis profits should be taxed away.
context: A windfall tax targets exceptional profits made because of a crisis, like soaring energy prices. Supporters call those profits unearned; critics say such taxes deter investment and change the rules after the fact.

origin.text_fr: Il faut instaurer une taxe sur les superprofits des entreprises pétrolières.

text: My country should step up its military support for Ukraine.
context: Military support means weapons, ammunition, training and funding. Supporters say it defends a country against invasion and deters further aggression; critics fear escalation and the cost.

origin.text_fr: La France doit soutenir davantage l'Ukraine militairement.

text: Controls at the EU's external borders should be tightened.
context: The EU's external borders are the frontiers of the passport-free Schengen area, so what happens there affects every member. Tighter controls mean more patrols, fences and checks, and raise questions about how people seeking asylum are treated.

origin.text_fr: Il faut renforcer les contrôles aux frontières extérieures de l'UE.

text: The EU should build a common European army.
context: A European army would mean a unified command of member states' forces, with a shared budget and a partial transfer of sovereignty over defence. Supporters say Europe must be able to defend itself; opponents prize national control.

origin.text_fr: La France doit développer une armée européenne commune.

text: Welfare benefits should be conditional on mandatory hours of work or volunteering.
context: Welfare conditions can include job-search requirements or compulsory hours of work, training or volunteering. Supporters say rights come with duties; critics say conditions push the most vulnerable out of support.

origin.text_fr: Le RSA doit rester conditionné à des heures d'activité ou de bénévolat obligatoires.

text: My country should maintain diplomatic relations with Russia.
context: Keeping diplomatic relations means keeping embassies and channels of dialogue open. The case for is that talking is the only path to peace; the case against is that it legitimises aggression.

origin.text_fr: La France doit maintenir des relations diplomatiques avec la Russie.

text: Facial recognition should be banned in public spaces.
context: Facial recognition identifies people from their faces, live or from recordings. Police say it helps catch suspects; critics say it enables mass surveillance and misidentifies people. This is about a total ban in public places.

origin.text_fr: Il faut interdire la reconnaissance faciale dans l'espace public.

text: Taxation should be harmonised across EU countries to prevent tax competition between states.
context: Some EU countries tax companies very lightly to attract their headquarters. Harmonisation would set common rules or a minimum rate on profits across the EU, limiting competition between member states.

origin.text_fr: Il faut harmoniser la fiscalité entre les pays de l'UE pour éviter la concurrence fiscale entre États.

text: My country needs a new constitution.
context: A constitution sets how power is shared between head of state, government, parliament and courts. Writing a new one is a way to reset a political system; critics say it distracts from fixing concrete problems.

origin.text_fr: Il faut passer à une VIe République.

text: Governments should not be able to pass laws without a vote in parliament.
context: Some constitutions let a government force a bill through without a final vote, daring parliament to bring it down instead. Critics call such tools undemocratic; defenders say they keep minority governments stable.

origin.text_fr: L'article 49.3 de la Constitution doit être supprimé.

text: Parliament should be given more power relative to the executive.
context: The balance between parliament and the executive varies. Where governments control the agenda, rely on emergency powers or rule by decree, parliament can become a rubber stamp. This is about shifting power back to parliament.

origin.text_fr: Il faut donner davantage de pouvoirs au Parlement face à l'exécutif.

text: The state should be able to seize empty homes to house people.
context: Cities often have homes standing empty while people sleep rough or wait years for social housing. Requisition lets the state take temporary control of empty homes to house people. Critics see it as an attack on property rights.

origin.text_fr: L'État doit pouvoir réquisitionner les logements laissés vides pour lutter contre la crise du logement.

text: No farm subsidies without strict environmental rules.
context: Farm subsidies are often paid per hectare or per unit produced, regardless of how the land is farmed. Strict conditions would tie them to practices like hedgerows, crop rotation and less pesticide.

origin.text_fr: Les aides agricoles doivent être conditionnées au respect de normes environnementales strictes.

text: Conspicuous religious symbols should be banned for everyone in public services, staff and users alike.
context: Some countries require strict religious neutrality in public life; others allow religious symbols freely. This is about banning conspicuous symbols (headscarf, kippah, large cross) for staff and users of public services alike.

origin.text_fr: Le port de signes religieux ostensibles doit être interdit pour tous dans les services publics, agents et usagers.

text: Menstrual leave should be introduced and paid for by the state.
context: Severe period pain, including endometriosis, is a common cause of missed work. Menstrual leave would allow paid days off without loss of pay. Supporters call it overdue; critics fear it could make employers wary of hiring women.

origin.text_fr: Le congé menstruel doit être instauré et remboursé par la Sécurité sociale.

text: Public broadcasting should get more public funding.
context: Public broadcasters are funded by a licence fee or directly from the state budget. Supporters say they provide independent news and culture the market won't; critics question paying for them and their neutrality.

origin.text_fr: L'État doit renforcer et augmenter le financement de l'audiovisuel public (France Télévisions, Radio France).

text: Sex education should be strengthened and made compulsory from primary school to the end of secondary school.
context: Sex education ranges from none at all to a compulsory curriculum from primary school. This is about making it thorough and compulsory, including consent, gender equality and reproductive health. Some parents want to decide this themselves.

origin.text_fr: L'éducation à la sexualité doit être renforcée et rendue obligatoire de l'école primaire au lycée.

text: Nobody should be allowed to earn more than a legal maximum.
context: A legal maximum income would tax away all income above a ceiling, often set as a multiple of the minimum or median wage. It is an absolute cap, not just a higher top tax rate.

origin.text_fr: Un revenu maximum légal doit être instauré.

text: No single owner should control too much of the news.
context: When a few owners control many TV channels, radio stations, newspapers and news sites, they can shape public debate. Anti-concentration rules cap how much media one owner can control, in the name of pluralism.

origin.text_fr: La loi doit limiter la concentration de la propriété des médias d'information.

text: Parents should be free to pick any school, not the one they're assigned.
context: Catchment areas assign children to a public school by where they live, aiming for a social mix, though better-off families often get round them by moving. Abolishing them would let every family choose, at the risk of widening gaps between schools.

origin.text_fr: La carte scolaire doit être supprimée pour permettre le libre choix de l'école.

text: The voting age should be lowered to 16.
context: Supporters of votes at 16 say young people live longest with today's decisions and that voting early builds the habit. Opponents say voting should match the age of legal adulthood.

origin.text_fr: Le droit de vote doit être abaissé à 16 ans.

text: Minimum welfare benefits should be raised significantly.
context: The lowest welfare benefits often sit below the poverty line. Raising them significantly would help recipients cover their basic needs; critics worry about the cost and about reducing the incentive to work.

origin.text_fr: Les minima sociaux (RSA, AAH) doivent être significativement augmentés.

text: National service should be compulsory for young people.
context: National service means a period of compulsory military or civilian service for young people. Supporters say it builds cohesion, skills and readiness; opponents object to the compulsion and the cost.

origin.text_fr: Le Service National Universel (SNU) doit être rendu obligatoire.

text: Public health insurance should cover 100% of healthcare costs.
context: Health systems differ in how much patients pay themselves, through fees, co-payments and private insurance. This is about the public system covering everything, paid for through taxes or contributions.

origin.text_fr: La Sécurité sociale doit prendre en charge 100 % des frais de santé.

text: Doctor shortages should be fixed with public clinics and salaried doctors.
context: Many rural and poor areas lack doctors. Public health centres employ salaried doctors instead of relying on self-employed doctors choosing where to work. This is about making them the main answer.

origin.text_fr: Les déserts médicaux doivent être traités par la création de centres de santé publics avec des médecins salariés.

text: Official documents should offer a third, neutral gender marker.
context: Official documents usually record only male or female. A third option, often marked X, would recognise non-binary and some intersex people. Opponents say sex should be recorded as a biological fact.

origin.text_fr: La France doit reconnaître une troisième mention de genre neutre sur les documents d'état civil.

text: Toll motorways should be brought back into public ownership.
context: Some motorways are run by private companies under long concessions, funded by tolls. Bringing them back into public ownership would end private profits from them, but the state would carry the cost of running them.

origin.text_fr: Les autoroutes doivent être renationalisées.

text: Advertising for unhealthy products (alcohol, tobacco, junk food) should be further restricted.
context: Advertising for tobacco and alcohol is already restricted in many places. This is about tightening the rules and extending them to junk food and sugary drinks. Critics see it as the nanny state.

origin.text_fr: La publicité pour les produits nocifs pour la santé (alcool, tabac, malbouffe) doit être davantage restreinte.

text: More social housing should be built.
context: Social housing is rented below market rates, usually by public or non-profit landlords. Building much more of it would cut waiting lists and rents, but takes significant public investment.

origin.text_fr: Il faut construire davantage de logements sociaux.

text: The state should be able to block social media in case of public disorder.
context: During unrest, social media can be used to coordinate violence. A legal power to block these services temporarily could help keep order, but is in tension with free expression and the right to information.

origin.text_fr: L'État doit pouvoir bloquer les réseaux sociaux en cas de troubles à l'ordre public.

text: Landlords should find it easier to evict tenants who don't pay their rent.
context: Evicting a tenant for unpaid rent can take many months. Faster evictions protect landlords' income and may encourage letting; critics say they push vulnerable people into homelessness.

origin.text_fr: Les propriétaires doivent avoir davantage de facilités pour expulser les locataires mauvais payeurs.

text: A tax should be introduced on fast fashion (cheap clothing produced abroad).
context: Fast fashion is cheap clothing made in large volumes, often in low-wage countries, and thrown away quickly. A tax would make prices reflect its environmental and social costs, but hit people on low incomes hardest.

origin.text_fr: Une taxe sur la fast fashion (vêtements produits à bas coût à l'étranger) doit être instaurée.

text: Ecocide should be a crime under national law.
context: Ecocide means the massive, deliberate destruction of an ecosystem. Making it a crime would let executives and officials be prosecuted for major environmental damage.

origin.text_fr: La France doit reconnaître le crime d'écocide dans son droit pénal.

text: Protected land should be opened up for housing.
context: Protected areas, like nature reserves, wetlands and green belts, have strict building rules. With housing short, this is about relaxing them to allow more construction.

origin.text_fr: Il faut faciliter la construction dans les zones protégées pour répondre aux besoins de logement.
